name: easyq
description: Question and answer platform for WordPress, based on Question2Answer.
author: easyQ

scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/easyq wp-content/plugins/easyq/languages/easyq.pot --exclude=vendor,node_modules,tests,artifacts,docs,build
scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run cli wp plugin check easyq --exclude-directories=vendor,node_modules,tests,artifacts,docs,.github --exclude-files=composer.json,composer.lock,package.json,package-lock.json,phpcs.xml.dist,phpstan.neon.dist,phpunit.xml.dist,phpunit-unit.xml.dist,phpunit-multisite.xml.dist,playwright.config.js,.wp-env.json,.editorconfig,.gitattributes,.gitignore,.phpcs-cache,.phpunit.result.cache
